desc: Read K, S, T from stdin; strip whitespace/newlines.
Quick reject: if abs(len(S) - len(T)) > K, print "No" and exit.
Implement banded edit distance DP: full-length rolling rows (size M+1), inner loop clamped to band [i-K, i+K], INF sentinel for out-of-band cells, bytes comparison for substitution cost.
Early termination: if any row's band values all exceed K, print "No" and exit.
After processing, check dp[M] <= K; print "Yes" or "No".
Verify edge cases mentally: equal strings (0 ops), length-1 strings, K larger than needed, samples (abc→awtf: K=3 Yes, K=2 No).
